clusters.description: Makhachev on Demetrious Johnson's MightyCast: Topuria lost focus/celebrated before Gaethje fight, but 'if he focuses he can be champion again'
clusters.doubt: Outlets pick different sentences (celebration video vs. 'can be champion again') and 244 runs six days late, but all cite the same DJ podcast conversation.

Malki Kawa (Topuria's manager) posts on social media asking for an immediate Gaethje rematch
clusters.doubt: Could be the same social post as the Kawa remarks in 193, which also contain a 'would kill Gaethje in a rematch' line.

clusters.description: Kawa (Topuria's manager) answers Abdelaziz's prediction that Usman Nurmagomedov would finish Topuria: 'shut up, Ilia would annihilate 100% of your roster'
clusters.doubt: Article bundles the Abdelaziz reply with a Gaethje-rematch defense that may be the 129 post.

clusters.description: Jesus Gallo (Topuria's S&C coach) talks to Jorge Ebro on YouTube about Topuria's recovery from facial fractures and a likely return date
Makhachev at the UFC 330 post-fight press conference says he accepted a White House fight with Topuria for good money and it fell apart the next day over Topuria's pay demands
clusters.doubt: Same speaker and same topic family as 03-a but a different occasion (press conference, not the podcast).

SPORT interview with creator 'MMARC' about his book on the UFC boom and Topuria's role in it

clusters.description: Myktybek Orolbai choked out by Jeremiah Wells at UFC 330 after being hyped as a Makhachev threat
Yahoo UFC power rankings after UFC 330
Namo Fazil claims he was attacked by 15 Chechens before his Contender Series loss (MMA Fighting Morning Report)

uncertain_pairs.why: Both quote Kawa on a Gaethje rematch from social media; 193's rematch line may be the same post as 129, though 193's main news is the reply to Abdelaziz three days later.
Both are Makhachev on Topuria in UFC 330 week and 138 already references the 'Topuria asked for more money' claim, but 228 is the post-fight press conference and 138 the DJ podcast.

148 folds in the 'should never have thrown a party' remark without naming the source, which could be an earlier Makhachev comment rather than the MightyCast; kept together because 144 places it on the same podcast.
